stride.control_or_reason: No transition exists by which the runtime acquires a DB credential; modelled as RuntimeNeverHoldsCredential, and the hardened spec has no AttemptAssume rule at all.
IRSA trust uses StringEquals on exact sub AND aud; no StringLike or wildcard on either axis.
No network path; proven by a same-run paired probe where runtime fails and migrator connects.
Denied serviceaccounts/token, impersonation and privileged-SA template creation. Mitigated not eliminated because the controller must still create its own envelopes.
SecureSecret is value-free; #40 RdsCredentialSecret is an anti-exemplar because the master value transits Pulumi state and etcd.
Persisted closed hulumi:role-kind discriminator; H3 requires the IaC tag only for deployment roles and fails closed on missing or unknown kinds.
Unreachable from the runtime pod or yields no role with secret/KMS access. Mitigated because reachability is an environment property, not a code one.
Owned by milestone M4. Marked na with the owning milestone named so it cannot be read as coverage.
Value-free identity receipts plus CloudTrail role-kind classification.

abuse_cases.attack_step: Re-reads the Aurora master secret after startup
abuse_cases.control: Effective-authorization denial on secretsmanager:GetSecretValue and kms:Decrypt, asserted with the evaluating policy named

abuse_cases.attack_step: Assumes the migrator or broker role
abuse_cases.control: sts:AssumeRole denied, tested transitively at every hop rather than first-hop only

abuse_cases.attack_step: Mints a token for the migrator ServiceAccount or mounts its token Secret
abuse_cases.control: Pairwise live negatives on serviceaccounts/token, impersonation, projected-volume and secretKeyRef mounts

abuse_cases.attack_step: Creates a Pod or Job naming a privileged ServiceAccount
abuse_cases.control: Admission rejects non-owning request identities per exact envelope

abuse_cases.surface: runtime network path to Aurora or RDS Proxy
abuse_cases.attack_step: Reaches Aurora or RDS Proxy directly
abuse_cases.control: Security-group and NetworkPolicy negative, with a same-run migrator success proving the endpoint exists

abuse_cases.surface: Pod Identity, node profile and instance metadata credential paths
abuse_cases.attack_step: Obtains credentials via Pod Identity association, agent, node profile or IMDS v1/v2
abuse_cases.control: Association absent and its creation denied; agent and IMDS unreachable from the runtime pod

abuse_cases.attack_step: Builds a serving Deployment from partial identity outputs
abuse_cases.control: Structural: no public constructor, no runnable outputs, no serving-output claim; NoServingBeforeValidated holds over the whole aggregate

abuse_cases.attack_step: Passes a free-form policy ARN or inline policy
abuse_cases.control: No policyArns or inlinePolicies; closed capability union where a member without both its matrix and its negative twin fails the build

residual_risks.risk: Superuser bypass of any PostgreSQL-side control
residual_risks.exploit_path: A PostgreSQL superuser bypasses row-level and object-level controls.
residual_risks.compensating_control: The serving runtime holds no database credential and has no direct database network path.

residual_risks.risk: Break-glass and control-plane exceptions not yet enumerated
residual_risks.exploit_path: An unnamed control-plane exception can mint or assume a privileged workload identity.
residual_risks.compensating_control: M1 must enumerate exact exceptions, keep them unavailable to workloads and test each path separately before execution.

residual_risks.risk: Live outcome evidence unavailable without an operator fixture
residual_risks.exploit_path: A run without the non-production fixture cannot demonstrate paired runtime denial and migrator success.
residual_risks.compensating_control: An absent fixture is blocked_by_operator and cannot be recorded as skipped or passed.
